titulo: Taking the call out of the room
caption:
Taking the call out of the room

Her phone rang in the middle of lunch. She was already walking out of the room when she answered.

A call taken in the hall costs ten steps, and the table keeps its conversation.

For whoever takes the call out of the room.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table and two plates with food on it on the right. A phone stands on the table and vibrates. A ink-black block figure with white eyes opens its eyes wide, picks the phone up with it and walks off the left side of the picture. A bubble from out of view says one sec! The figure walks back in with the phone and its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text stays: me taking the call out of the room.
